Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the taxpayer business contractor act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing information to the legislature aboutthe performance of state contracts for goods or services; adding a newsection to chapter 43.19 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the efficient useof state resources for the public good requires effective oversight ofstate contracts for goods and services. The legislature further findsthat information about the performance of these contracts from those inthe private sector who have contracted with the state is necessary foreffective oversight of these contracts.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A contract for the purchase of goods or services entered into witha private sector contractor must contain a clause substantiallyincluding the following requirement: The contractor agrees to identifyand make reasonably available an employee of the contractor who isknowledgeable about this contract to appear before, and to answer p. 1 HB 2444questions of, the Washington state legislature about the performance ofthis contract's obligations.
This act may be known and cited as thetaxpayer business contractor act.
